name: Seagate Technology

eyebrow.en: Seagate Technology Holdings plc · Ordinary shares · Singapore / Dublin
eyebrow.zh: 希捷科技 · 普通股 · 新加坡 / 都柏林

title.en: AI needs somewhere to keep its data, and Seagate is sold out.
title.zh: AI 的数据总得有地方存，希捷的硬盘已售罄。

lede.en: Hard drives still hold most of the world's cloud data, and AI has made them scarce. Seagate's revenue rose 48% last quarter to $3.6B at a record 52% gross margin, its new HAMR drives are ramping, and nearline capacity is largely allocated through 2027. The worry: rivals like Toshiba are now adding capacity.
lede.zh: 全球云端数据大多仍存放在机械硬盘上，而 AI 让硬盘供不应求。希捷上季营收增长 48% 至 36 亿美元，毛利率创纪录达 52%，新一代 HAMR 硬盘正在放量，近线产能 2027 年前已大致分配完毕。隐忧：东芝等对手正在扩产。

s.zh: 9月季度指引每股 $7.30 × 4 · 明年一致预期约 14 倍
±1 亿 · 每股 $7.30 · 营业利润率约 50%

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. Seagate more than tripled in a year, then fell about 28% from its June high as investors priced in more supply.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。希捷一年内涨逾三倍，随后因市场计入供给增加，较6月高点回落约 28%。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Seagate's fiscal year ends around July 1, so FQ1 is the September quarter. The last bar is company guidance at the midpoint.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。希捷财年约在7月1日结束，财年第一季为9月季度。最后一根柱为公司指引中值。

s.zh: FY26 末近线出货 EB 占比
债务 39 亿、现金 17 亿 · 2026年6月

p.en: Nearline drive capacity is reported to be almost fully allocated through calendar 2027, and long-term agreements now stretch into 2028, which supports pricing.
p.zh: 据报道，近线硬盘产能在 2027 年前几乎已全部分配，长期协议已延伸至 2028 年，支撑售价。

p.en: Mozaic HAMR drives store more per platter. The CFO said incremental gross margin is well above 60%, and half of HAMR exabytes should be on Mozaic 4 by the end of 2026.
p.zh: Mozaic HAMR 硬盘单盘容量更高。CFO 表示增量毛利率远高于 60%，预计 2026 年底一半 HAMR 出货将采用 Mozaic 4。

p.en: Free cash flow reached $1.1B last quarter and $3.1B for FY26. Seagate repaid $1.4B of debt in the year and pays a dividend while buying back stock.
p.zh: 上季自由现金流 11 亿美元，FY26 合计 31 亿。全年偿债 14 亿美元，并在派息之外回购股票。

p.en: On Oct 2 a report that Toshiba will double its AI hard-drive capacity by fiscal 2027 knocked 10% off Seagate. More supply could end the shortage pricing sooner.
p.zh: 10月2日有报道称东芝将在 2027 财年前把 AI 硬盘产能翻倍，希捷当天下跌 10%。供给增加可能让短缺溢价提前结束。

p.en: Bloomberg reported on Oct 6 that Seagate and Toshiba are bidding for TDK's magnetic-heads business, worth up to several billion dollars. The stock fell 9% that day.
p.zh: 彭博 10月6日报道，希捷与东芝正竞购 TDK 磁头业务，交易额或达数十亿美元。希捷当天下跌 9%。

p.en: Drive makers have swung from shortage to glut before: Seagate lost money in several quarters of FY23–24. A slowdown in cloud spending would hit pricing fast.
p.zh: 硬盘行业曾多次从短缺转为过剩：希捷在 FY23–24 有数个季度亏损。云端开支一旦放缓，价格会迅速受压。

p.en: Guide: $4.1B ±$100M revenue, ~50% operating margin, EPS $7.30. Watch whether capacity stays sold out.
p.zh: 指引：营收 41 亿 ±1 亿美元，营业利润率约 50%，每股 $7.30。关注产能是否仍售罄。

p.en: Management targets half of HAMR exabytes on Mozaic 4 by the end of calendar 2026.
p.zh: 管理层目标在 2026 年底前一半 HAMR 出货采用 Mozaic 4。

p.en: Date not yet announced; December-quarter results usually come in late January.
p.zh: 日期未公布；12月季度业绩通常于1月下旬发布。

sources: Q4 FY26 and fiscal 2026 results (press release)
Q4 FY26 recap: guide, HAMR and margins (TIKR)
Toshiba capacity report and Oct 2 selloff
TDK heads-unit bidding and Oct 6 drop
Price, market cap and beta: Yahoo Finance, as of Oct 9, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Seagate Technology Holdings plc.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Seagate Technology Holdings plc 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 16 quarters from FQ1 2023 to FQ4 2026. Seagate's fiscal year ends around July 1. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 FY23 第一季至 FY26 第四季共 16 个季度。希捷财年约在7月1日结束。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Seagate's cash flow tracks the drive cycle. Through the FY23–24 downturn it stayed slightly positive by cutting capex to about $50–70M a quarter. As AI demand tightened supply, quarterly free cash flow climbed from $27M in FQ1 2025 to $1.1B in FQ4 2026, and the last four quarters add up to $3.1B.
read.zh: 希捷的现金流随硬盘周期起伏。FY23–24 下行期间，公司把每季资本开支压到约 0.5–0.7 亿美元，自由现金流仍略为正。随 AI 需求令供给吃紧，季度自由现金流从 FY25 第一季的 2700 万美元升至 FY26 第四季的 11 亿美元，近四季合计 31 亿。

read.en: My base case uses the September-quarter guide ($4.1B revenue at ~50% operating margin) and assumes modest growth and capex of about $250M a quarter, which gives roughly $7.1B of free cash flow over four quarters. The main risk is pricing: if Toshiba and others add supply faster than cloud demand grows, margins could fall back quickly, as in 2023.
read.zh: 我的基准情景采用9月季度指引（营收 41 亿美元、营业利润率约 50%），假设温和增长及每季约 2.5 亿美元资本开支，四季自由现金流约 71 亿美元。主要风险是价格：若东芝等对手扩产快于云端需求增长，利润率可能像 2023 年那样迅速回落。

p.en: Seagate retired $1.4B of debt in FY26, including $302M in the June quarter.
p.zh: FY26 偿债 14 亿美元，其中6月季度 3.02 亿。

p.en: $810M returned to shareholders in FY26; the dividend is $0.74 a share each quarter.
p.zh: FY26 回馈股东 8.1 亿美元；季度股息每股 $0.74。

p.en: Capex stays light, around 4–5% of revenue, mostly to convert lines to Mozaic drives.
p.zh: 资本开支保持轻量，约为营收的 4–5%，主要用于产线转向 Mozaic 硬盘。

p.en: Gross margin rose from 37% to 52% in a year as pricing and the HAMR mix improved.
p.zh: 随价格与 HAMR 产品组合改善，毛利率一年内从 37% 升至 52%。

p.en: Data center revenue grew 57% to $2.9B on 195 exabytes shipped.
p.zh: 数据中心营收增长 57% 至 29 亿美元，出货 195 EB。

p.en: Long-term agreements reach into 2028, giving visibility on volumes and price.
p.zh: 长期协议延伸至 2028 年，为销量与价格提供能见度。

bridgeEnd.en: Before buybacks and debt paydown, Jun 2027 (est.)

bridgeNote.en: Most of this is likely to go to buybacks, dividends and debt reduction rather than sit on the balance sheet.
bridgeNote.zh: 大部分现金料将用于回购、派息与降债，而非留在资产负债表上。

extraNote.en: A possible bid for TDK's heads business, reported at up to several billion dollars, is not included.
extraNote.zh: 未计入可能竞购 TDK 磁头业务的支出（据报道或达数十亿美元）。
